response.overview: Outlook storage can become full when your mailbox contains too many emails, 1(855)618-5423 attachments, 1(855)618-5423 deleted messages, 1(855)618-5423 or other stored content. 1(855)618-5423 Start by checking your mailbox storage information to identify what is using the most space. 1(855)618-5423 Remove unnecessary messages and large attachments, 1(855)618-5423 then empty Deleted Items and Junk Email if appropriate. 1(855)618-5423 You can also save important attachments elsewhere before removing them from your mailbox. 1(855)618-5423 After cleaning up space, 1(855)618-5423 restart Outlook and allow time for the account to synchronize. 1(855)618-5423 If storage remains full, 1(855)618-5423 review your Microsoft account storage settings for additional details. 1(855)618-5423
